evaluation.initial_assistant_visual_review: NEGATIVE_DIRECTIONAL_NOT_PROFESSIONAL; C and B share essentially same skeleton/appearance; C has slightly different thickness and terminations but not the brush mass/letterform decisions shown by D.
evaluation.observed_small_gain: No reliable artistic improvement visually identifiable over A/B; additional pixel differences are not quality evidence.
evaluation.key_fail: R5 applied authentic corpus-conditioned terminal width and tip curvature, but did NOT re-author entire stroke gestures, overall letterform structure, interstroke negative space or whole-word optical rhythm. The source font oracle D visibly remains a much more authored design.
evaluation.do_not_repeat: Do not re-tune C until it looks better: that would convert the controlled role-method test into unbounded per-glyph manual polish and fake method generalization.

engineering_failures_preserved.correction: Replaced 2-D np.cross with determinant; substantive CI role_atlas_gate_pass assertion; reran to extract 294 usable geometry-associated terminals

next_research_gate.name: R6_FULL_STROKE_GESTURE_AND_COMPONENT_SPACE_TRANSFER
next_research_gate.reason: Tip cap/width is too weak a representation of professional authored lettering.
next_research_gate.required_evidence: Same-style glyph family whole-stroke examples with reliably attributable stroke-role boundaries; a procedurally meaningful model of pen path curvature, turn and relative spatial rebalancing; avoid automatic source-to-target contour copying.
next_research_gate.minimum_test: On a new truly held-out glyph group freeze one generation each of A baseline/B R2/C R6 and D oracle; preserve exact characters; inspect meaningful changes in silhouette, negative space, and strong visual design; independent human blind review required to promote.
next_research_gate.stop: If whole-stroke examples cannot be reliably identified in finished glyph source without author annotations, label nonidentifiable. Seek documented design process or a font file with stroke-level source, not another number-driven cap tweak.
